artworks.title: The Death of Hyacinthos
artworks.description: Broc's Neoclassical canvas — Apollo cradling the Spartan youth struck by the discus, the flower still to rise from the spilled blood.

artworks.title: The Death of Hyacinth (La morte di Giacinto)
artworks.description: Tiepolo's Thyssen canvas updates the fatal sport with tennis racquet and balls — Apollo's grief under a luminous Rococo sky.

artworks.title: Apollo and Hyacinth (fresco, Palazzo Farnese)
artworks.description: Domenichino's Farnese fresco — the god bending over the fallen prince, athletic play reversed into mourning in Ovid's Book X.

artworks.title: Apollo, Hyacinthus and Cyparissus Playing Music and Singing
artworks.description: Ivanov's idyll before the discus — Apollo at music with Hyacinthus and Cyparissus, the bloom of youth that makes the later death cut deeper.

music.title: Apollo et Hyacinthus
music.description: Mozart's first opera Latin school-drama stages the discus death — Hyacinthus as Apollo's beloved on a Salzburg stage.
